Latest code found in the WhatsApp TestFlight version shows that Meta is developing an iCloud backup alternative for iPhone users. Details below.

WhatsApp Developing Its Own Backup Service

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is developing its own cloud backup service for iPhone users, as an alternative option besides iCloud.

The feature has not yet been opened to WhatsApp TestFlight users, but WABetaInfo successfully activated an interface that lets users choose the backup location between iCloud and WhatsApp's own cloud service. The interface shows it will offer 2GB of free storage, while the report indicates that paid plans can provide up to 1TB of capacity.

The report also mentioned that users can choose themselves whether WhatsApp backups on iCloud use end-to-end encryption, but WhatsApp's own first-party backup system will use end-to-end encryption by default.

WABetaInfo pointed out:

Although there is no official launch timetable for this feature yet, the report mentions that WhatsApp is also developing a Google Drive backup alternative for Android users. Since work on both platforms is proceeding simultaneously, this feature may hopefully be officially announced in the near future.
